title: Good cutter, but hard to clean
text:
Good cutter, but hard to clean. The wheel cutter operates easily and well. It had no trouble cutting any pizza I tried.

The problem is that having half the blade covered means that the ability to clean the blade completely is limited. I have also seen food particles stuck in the upper half and blade guard. these unsanitary conditions concern me.

I personally am probably going back to a cutter with an exposed wheel.
